scope:
Separate coarse format bounds, fixed-W bounds and normalized-P invariants.

Normalized P proof applies after a fixed-head-scale softmax+quantization stage.
It does not cover unnormalized online-attention O feedback, variable V scales,
or an unimplemented integer softmax. All extra guards/limb operations have costs.

counter_contract.P_sum_counter: U32 per active query/head; compare with declared budget before accepting result
counter_contract.V_scale: one immutable per-head dyadic exponent for all participating keys
counter_contract.PV16x16: three nonnegative radix128 P limbs and three signed balanced-radix128 V limbs,9 S8 products plus shifts/adds; not a free16bit multiplier

counter_contract.excluded: unnormalized online O updates, varying V scale across pages/tokens, full model quality or target cycle/PPA
